name: Conjuration Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Entangle; Misty Step; Conjure Animals; Dimension Door; Conjure Elemental. Concentration saves for Conjuration spells add the modifier of the ability increased by this feat.
